description: A collection of biological sequences. The GA4GH seqcol v1.0.0 extended schema (names, lengths, sequences and the approved ancillary attributes, with the qualifiers of spec section 5), plus refbook's named_sequences and sorted_named_sequences.

lengths.description: Number of elements, such as nucleotides or amino acids, in each sequence.

names.description: Human-readable labels of each sequence (chromosome names).

items.description: Refget sequences v2 identifiers for sequences.

name_length_pairs.description: Human-readable labels paired with number of elements in each sequence.

name.description: Human-readable label of the sequence (chromosome name).

length.description: Number of elements, such as nucleotides or amino acids, in the sequence.

sorted_name_length_pairs.description: The digest of each name-length pair, sorted lexicographically: an order-invariant coordinate system (spec 5.2).

items.description: Refget sequences v2 identifiers for sequences.

named_sequences.description: refbook: the digest of each {"name", "sequence"} pair, as spec footnote F1 suggests.

sorted_named_sequences.description: refbook: named_sequences, sorted lexicographically. Its level-1 digest identifies the named sequence set whatever the order; it is a refbook edition's id.
